changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: Pin each verified Slack DM to its original producer for its retention window.
changeSet.sql: SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '5s'; ALTER TABLE connection ADD COLUMN slack_dm_pin_epoch timestamptz DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL; CREATE TABLE slack_dm_producer_pin ( id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, workspace_id bigint NOT NULL, connection_id bigint NOT NULL, team_id varchar(64) NOT NULL, channel_id varchar(64) NOT NULL, source_ts varchar(17) NOT NULL, thread_root varchar(17), author varchar(64), account_id bigint, producer varchar(16) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT uk_slack_dm_producer_pin_source UNIQUE (workspace_id, connection_id, channel_id, source_ts), CONSTRAINT sfk_slack_dm_producer_pin_connection FOREIGN KEY (connection_id, workspace_id) REFERENCES connection (id, workspace_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, CONSTRAINT ck_slack_dm_producer_pin_producer CHECK (producer IN ('LEGACY', 'MENTOR')) );
changeSet.rollback: DROP TABLE slack_dm_producer_pin; ALTER TABLE connection DROP COLUMN slack_dm_pin_epoch;
